## Checks

- cakestand.blend: TurntablePlate origin vs bounds centre (XY): 0.000 mm OK

## Mismatches with the decorating plan

- The plan says `moulds.py` holds the cake and cupcake in four bake states. They are in `build/muffin_tin_<state>.blend` and `build/cake_tin_<state>.blend` (one file per dish and state), plus `build/cake_turnout.blend` (the turned-out golden cake). cake_maps.py reads those.
- There is no `studio.py` top-down sprite camera. New scripts place a temporary orthographic camera from `camera.json` `plate_topdown`/`topdown` conventions via `deco_common.sprite_camera()` and keep `studio.use()` for the lights and world.
- The plan names a `transition.py`. The oven-to-stand move already exists in the app (`StationMoveView`, `TongsView`, `station_export.py`), so it is skipped.
- The plan's `build/stage.blend` does not exist; the stage is assembled from `slab.blend`, `cakestand.blend` and `oven.blend` (as `slab.py` does). focus.py does the same.
